basic_profile.bio: Avid reader and aspiring creator of webcomics, navigating the digital landscape to find the best platforms for sharing my art. Originally from Portland, I spend most evenings and weekends online, balancing my day job in tech support with my passion for visual storytelling. In a relationship, and often found collaborating with my partner on creative projects.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design and a keen interest in webcomic storytelling. I learned the basics of drawing and digital art through online courses and practice. My work in tech support has also given me a solid understanding of different online platforms and their quirks.
